policy: Reference-led research with explicit best guesses, zero variants included, famous multimedia prioritized; no requirement to invent a canonical census or read entire obscure works.
review_method: Assistant case-by-case source-led passes plus targeted completion review; not independent peer review and not a guarantee that every fictional interpretation is uniquely correct.

requirements.evidence: Attachment objective, статья.txt and coordinates.png were read; the image and six article categories agree with the saved axis conventions.
890 retained records, not discovery leads; 510 pass the deliberately conservative resident-community counting rule without relying on narrowly worded employee/individual cases.
784 original candidate IDs remain frozen, 149 append-only leads complete the 933-candidate ledger; 106 base batches and 55 ordered revisions preserve complete before/after history.
Explicit coverage checks include Cyberpunk, Matrix, Star Wars, Star Trek, Marvel/DC, Mass Effect, Deus Ex, BioShock and known anime; the first Edgerunners series has an official anime setting source.
All 890 names/descriptions are English and each description has at least two paragraphs and 110 words. The source-backed argument and limits are included in the data.
Every record has numeric guarantees, control and nonworking values plus bounded assessments and source references. Values are editorial estimates rather than fictional census measurements.
Regimes 1–6 represent the six combinations in the article. Every zero variant is separately typed with regime 0, and its analogous regime remains visible.

Descriptions and populations retain care, voluntary useful creation, assigned work and sentient-person activity. Review corrected Manna’s unemployment shortcut and Comarre’s active dream-person scope.

Sibyl remains human-brain collective authority; human-derived uploads are not automatically unrelated AI. Completion review widens Alt/Control alternatives while preserving actual autonomous-machine examples.

All records have named continuity, period, population and exclusions; selected endings, hypothetical material consequences and player configurations carry their actual scope. Logan novel/film/TV and other important variants remain separate.
Every record has an allowed nonempty media array. Shared material models use multiple actual media; unrelated/unreleased adaptations are not inferred from franchise labels.

Every record links registered sources; all sources retain access method, date, bounded read scope and limitations. Indexed excerpts and reader interpretations are identified rather than represented as complete primary reads.

requirements.requirement: Requested best guesses instead of lore skips
requirements.evidence: No needs_evidence or pending decisions remain. 853 records explicitly use best_guess; 37 earlier source-led records retain evidence, uncertainties and axis assessments. Contextual mechanisms are not represented as canonical laws.

21 actual shared-model leads are linked, 29 identified different-mechanism comparisons have completed assessments outside the target, and materially different cultures/periods are split rather than silently merged.

The completed current-policy pass revisits old holds individually. Targeted final reviews cover named franchises, employment versus useful activity, consciousness, controller origin, media and the Jupiter/New Mars source correction; review is not independent peer review.
Only research data/utilities/docs were produced. No website/app/deployment was built. All 890 asset fields explicitly defer poster/icon collection as the user allowed.
Merge, validation, checkpoint and quality-audit utilities pass. A final clean-rebuild hash check covers authoritative and generated outputs after this review is recorded.

limitations: Coordinates and many institutional details are explicitly uncertain best guesses, as requested; they are not canonical statistics.
Some records are projected or historical reconstructions, and some are narrow household/work/proxy comparisons. Their actual scope is not a universal claim about an entire franchise.
Source references preserve what was read, including bounded indexes and criticism. This review does not claim all URLs are currently reachable or that the whole works were read.
Conscious synthetic/collective person cases are comparative and keep their assumptions visible.
Images remain deferred; no site or deployment is delivered.
